result:
Looking at the qlang documentation and tasks, I'll write each query based on the language semantics.

Let me analyze the key patterns:
- Filter with conditions: `filter ~(...)`
- Map over elements: `*`
- Group by value: `groupBy` or by key: `groupBy ~(key)`
- Handle missing/null: `at` (soft read), `coalesce` (default value)
- Sort: `sort ~([key modifier])` with `desc` for descending
- Convert case: `lower` and `keyword` for strings/keywords

O1: Filter by status (case-insensitive), sum totals treating null/missing as 0
O2: Filter out cancelled, extract regions, group and count
O3: Filter by state and label (case-insensitive), sort by comments desc then number asc, take 3
O4: Filter non-null assignees, extract logins, lowercase, deduplicate and sort
O5: Combine dependencies entries, filter starting with "^", extract names, sort
O6: Filter by city (case-insensitive), map to objects with email fallback
O7: Filter enabled and with port, reduce to map with name->port
O8: Filter by exact type, extract durations, filter nulls, compute average
O9: Split lines by spaces, extract paths, group and count, sort and take top 2
O10: Parse CSV, filter non-empty salaries, group by dept, compute averages
O11: Filter non-blank, non-comment, with "==", extract names, lowercase and sort
O12: Split by comma and colon, group by lowercase name, sum values
O13: Flatten items, group by SKU, sum qty, sort and take top 3
O14: Filter closed issues, check all have assignee

O1: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") | * (/total | coalesce 0) | sum

O2: filter ~(/status | lower | ne "cancelled") | * /region | groupBy | * count

O3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~((/labels | filter ~(lower | eq "bug") | count) | gt 0) | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * /number

O4: filter ~((at /assignee) | ne null) | * /assignee/login | * lower | distinct | sort

O5: [(/dependencies | entries) (/devDependencies | entries)] | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * /0 | sort

O6: filter ~(/address/city | lower | eq "berlin" !| false) | * {:id /id :name /name :email (at /email | coalesce null)}

O7: /services | filter ~((at /enabled | coalesce true) | if ~(ne false) ~(has /port) ~(false)) | reduce {} ~(union {:(/name | keyword) /port})

O8: /data/items | filter ~(/type | eq "click") | * (at /duration_ms) | filter ~(ne null) | {:sum (sum) :count (count)} | /sum | div /count | round 2

O9: lines | * (split " " | /2) | groupBy | * count | entries | * {:path /0 :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /path]) | take 2

O10: lines | drop 1 | * (split "," | {:dept (/1 | keyword) :salary (/2 | if (ne "") ~(parseJson) ~(null))}) | filter ~(/salary | ne null) | groupBy ~(/dept) | * {:sum (reduce 0 ~(add /salary)) :count (count)} | * (/sum | div /count | round 1)

O11: lines | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~((startsWith "#" | not)) | filter ~(contains "==") | * (split "==" | /0 | lower) | sort | join ","

O12: split "," | * (trim | split ":" | {:name (/0 | lower) :value (/1 | parseJson)}) | groupBy ~(/name) | * (reduce 0 ~(add /value))

O13: * /items | * {:sku /sku :qty /qty} | groupBy ~(/sku) | * (reduce 0 ~(add /qty)) | entries | * {:sku /0 :qty /1} | sort ~([(/qty | desc) /sku]) | take 3

O14: filter ~(/state | eq "closed") | * (/assignee | ne null) | every
